Here are some fun facts about Cornell, provided to you by Nika Self:

- When Stanford visited Cornell, he was so inspired that when Stanford was built the structure of the institution was modeled after Cornell. For awhile Stanford was called the Cornell of the West.
  
- There is a debate between Ithaca New York and Two Rivers Wisconsin over the birthplace of the ice cream sundae. Ithaca has written proof of the sundae being made in 1892, while Two Rivers has oral reports of the sundae in 1881.

- Ithaca has three drinking water plants, which is an unusually high amount for the population. You would expect one. Cornell has it's one with the water coming from Fall creek, the main treatment plant gets it's water from Cayuga lake and the smallest one gets it's water from six mile creek.
